description: Read per-conversation evaluation results - scores, per-turn labels, reasons and the transcript. Takes eval_ids, which is a different kind of id from the job_id that mba_get_eval_results takes. Read them from the eval_ids_by_score field of a completed job. mba_get_eval_results already adds these details when it can read that field, so call this tool when it could not.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_get_eval_details
title: Read evaluation details
